\[
R=X^+,\qquad q=Y^+,\qquad r=Z^+.
\]
Folding across the uncut edges and identifying the third vertex with the opposite sign each time gives:
\[
\begin{array}{c|cccccccccc}
\text{net} &P&Q&R&S&p&q&r&s&T&U\\\hline
\text{octahedron}&Y^-&Z^-&X^+&Y^-&X^-&Y^+&Z^+&X^-&Y^-&X^-
\end{array}
\]

Thus
\[
x=Pp \quad\text{has endpoints}\quad Y^- \text{ and } X^-.
\]
Among the choices,
\[
B=Ss \quad\text{also has endpoints}\quad Y^- \text{ and } X^-,
\]
so edge \(B\) coincides with \(x\) when folded.
